q: The Hopf-Rinow theorem in Riemannian geometry states that a connected Riemannian manifold is geodesically complete (all geodesics extend indefinitely) if and only if it is:
opts: Complete as a metric space (every Cauchy sequence converges)
exp: Hopf-Rinow: geodesic completeness ↔ metric completeness ↔ 'every closed bounded set is compact' (Heine-Borel property). Additionally, geodesic completeness implies any two points can be joined by a length-minimizing geodesic.
